dataflow.name: Sidewalk editing and Street View inspection: synthetic fixture
dataflow.description: Small portable schematic input fixture. Automatic map-to-editor handoff is blocked on the upstream interaction prerequisite; see the walkthrough.
dataflow.task: Load both explicit sources and Prepare. See the documented upstream selection blocker before attempting automatic tile handoff.

nodes.title: Synthetic imagery reference
nodes.goal: Declare the verified synthetic RGB GeoTIFF, grid, tile images and georeferencing.
nodes.content:
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("docs/examples/data/sidewalk-synthetic")
image = root / "synthetic.tif"
grid = root / "tile-grid.geojson"
sidecar = json.loads((root / "mosaic-provenance.json").read_text())
actual = hashlib.sha256(image.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
if actual != sidecar["mosaic"]["sha256"]:
    raise ValueError("Synthetic mosaic differs from its verified sidecar")
grid_hash = hashlib.sha256(grid.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
if grid_hash != sidecar["gridSha256"]:
    raise ValueError("Synthetic grid differs from its verified sidecar")
return {
    "kind": "sidewalk-image",
    "datasetId": "synthetic-six-tiles",
    "sha256": actual,
    "source": {
        "type": "geotiff",
        "geotiffFileUrl": "docs/examples/data/sidewalk-synthetic/synthetic.tif",
        "outputTableName": "synthetic_rgb",
        "coordinateFormat": sidecar["mosaic"]["crs"],
    },
    "gridUrl": "docs/examples/data/sidewalk-synthetic/tile-grid.geojson",
    "boundariesUrl": "docs/examples/data/sidewalk-synthetic/tile-boundaries.geojson",
    "imageUrlTemplate": "docs/examples/data/sidewalk-synthetic/tiles/{tile_id}.png",
    "georeferencing": {
        "crs": sidecar["mosaic"]["crs"],
        "bounds": sidecar["mosaic"]["bounds"],
        "gridSha256": grid_hash,
        "mapping": sidecar["mosaic"]["mapping"],
    },
}

nodes.title: Original sidewalk network
nodes.goal: Declare and load the unedited EPSG:4326 sidewalk network.
nodes.content:
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("docs/examples/data/sidewalk-synthetic/overview-network.geojson")
raw = path.read_bytes()
return {
    "kind": "sidewalk-network",
    "datasetId": "synthetic-six-tiles",
    "url": "docs/examples/data/sidewalk-synthetic/overview-network.geojson",
    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
    "crs": "EPSG:4326",
    "data": json.loads(raw),
}
